_about: Read by the October Journey installers each time they run. Change it here (on GitHub) and the next install uses it; no rebuild needed.

servers.name: October Journey
servers.note: Through Tailscale: you need to be on (or shared into) the owner's Tailscale network.

_servers_later: To add a public address later, add another entry such as { "name": "October Journey (public)", "address": "play.example.com" }.

art._source: Original artwork made for October Journey (tools/make_art.ps1); stored in this repo, paths relative to repo_raw.
